visible_description: 一排会哼歌的石头，给路过的蜗牛留出了一个安静的拍子。
synopsis: 在这个原创童话里，花园里几颗圆石子每到傍晚就哼歌。今天它们排得太密，声音全挤在一起，一只路过的蜗牛也找不到通过的空隙。最小的石子往旁边挪了挪，留出一条窄窄的路。蜗牛慢慢经过时，石头们恰好停了一拍；等歌声再响起来，大家都觉得这次的停顿尤其好听。
story_text:
花园里有五颗会哼歌的石子，每到傍晚便排成一列。今天大家站得有点近，五个小嘴巴一起张开，歌声像挤在一只太小的杯子里。

一只蜗牛沿小路过来，想从石头中间穿过去，却找不到空隙。它停在那儿，抬起细触角，五颗石子这才看见队伍前方多了一位听众。

最小的黄石子先向旁边滚了一点，绿石子也收了收身子，中间露出一条窄路。蜗牛慢慢通过时，大家都把嘴巴合上，安静看着它的壳。

等蜗牛走远，石子们又接着唱。黄石子没有回到原来的位置，旁边留出的空处让晚风也能经过。那一小会儿没有声音的地方，后来便成了这首歌里大家最喜欢的一拍。

character_design: Exactly FIVE original friendly singing garden pebbles appear in every panel, always all five fully inside the frame. Their five permanent identities are: a cream upright egg-shaped stone; a dusty-blue low rounded stone; ONE ochre-yellow tiny flat oval stone, clearly the smallest; a sage-green pear-shaped stone with one pale side patch; and a warm-gray broad rounded wedge. Each has two dot eyes and one tiny mouth. There is no second yellow or ochre stone and no tall yellow stone. Use one fixed wide elevated three-quarter camera angle for all four panels so all stones remain individually countable. The initial left-to-right row order is cream, blue, tiny yellow, sage, gray. The cream and blue stones stay in their left positions and sage and gray stay in their right positions throughout. Only the tiny yellow center stone changes position, rolling a short step diagonally forward-left in panels 3-4; it remains fully visible beside and in front of the blue stone without overlapping or hiding any neighbor. This leaves its former center position empty as a passage between the stationary blue and sage stones. One snail has a visibly brown spiral shell, soft cream extended body, head and two feelers; it is clearly a snail, not another pebble. The plain smooth path has no gravel, other rocks, flowers with stone-like centers, loose shell, or pebble decorations. Low grass and warm evening light form the uncluttered background. These are gentle fictional characters with no lettering.
